Read NARP (Airport) File

Source: R/read_narp.R
read_narp.Rd

This function parses SAAM/Gasel .narp files. These files contain a comprehensive list of airports, including their ICAO codes, names, coordinates, and traffic sequencing parameters.

The file structure is defined as follows:

  • Extension: narp

  • Separator: Semicolon (;)

  • Coordinate System: Decimal degrees

The file consists of:

  1. First Line: Metadata starting with # (e.g., version, dates, record count).

  2. Body Lines: Records defining individual airports.

Record Structure:

  • Field 1: ICAO Code (4 characters)

  • Field 2: Airport Name

  • Field 3: Latitude (Decimal Degrees)

  • Field 4: Longitude (Decimal Degrees)

  • Field 5: TIS (Time to Insert into Sequence - minutes)

  • Field 6: TRS (Time to Remove from Sequence - minutes)

  • Field 7: Taxi Time (minutes)

  • Field 8: Altitude (Flight Levels)

Note on TIS/TRS: Underscores ("_") in numeric fields (TIS, TRS, TaxiTime) indicate missing data and are converted to NA.

Usage

read_narp(narp_file)

Arguments

narp_file

Path to the .narp file.

Value

A data.table with the following columns:

  • icao: Character (4-letter ICAO code).

  • name: Character (Airport name).

  • lat: Numeric (Latitude).

  • lon: Numeric (Longitude).

  • tis: Numeric (Time to Insert).

  • trs: Numeric (Time to Remove).

  • taxitime: Numeric.

  • altitude: Numeric (Flight Level).

Details

Reads a .narp file defining airport metadata, location, and operational parameters.
